title: spec: a translation item accepts any `locale` string ("not a locale!!" saves 200, valid) — LocaleSchema is a bare z.string()
body:
> **Premise checked before dispatch** (domain:spec seat 2, 2026-10-26): readings and corrections in comment 6409913684 (https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/25822#issuecomment-6409913684). The goal below is unchanged.

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a live reproduction (finding class (a)). The fix narrows a published accept set, so it is Clause-② narrowing work for the spec lane.
Business reason: a translator or AI author who mistypes a locale (`zh_CN`, `zh-cn ` with a space, a language name) gets a green save. Their strings are stored under a locale that no session will ever ask for, so the app silently shows untranslated text. This is the "not translated yet" failure that #4001 closed for unknown keys, still open for the locale value itself.
Reader: the `packages/spec` lane (`src/system/translation.zod.ts`, `LocaleSchema`, also used as the bundle map key); the next spec minor's narrowing batch.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "translation locale not validated BCP-47 any string accepted" → 5 hits, none of them this one. The nearest is #15757 (exact-match locale fallback in the validation-message bridge), a different defect.
reach: public HTTP entry, measured on a fresh stock showcase boot, `main` 6679644a, as admin.
Checklist item priority: P1
type: Bug
QA-source: #25817 · i18n.strict-translation-key-rejection · observed beside the clauses

Reproduction:
1. As admin, send `PUT /api/v1/meta/translation/qa_bad_locale` with body `{"name":"qa_bad_locale","locale":"not a locale!!","objects":{"showcase_task":{"label":"x"}}}`.
2. It answers 200 with `_diagnostics.valid: true`, and the read-back serves it.

**Expected:** 422 `INVALID_METADATA`, naming `locale` as not a BCP-47 tag, at both the save door and `defineTranslation` / `defineTranslationBundle`. That matches how the same item already refuses unknown keys.

**Mechanism:** `LocaleSchema` is `z.string()` with only a description of "BCP-47 Language Tag". No form check exists.

**Not confirmed beyond the save and read-back:** that no session resolves the stored strings.
